summary: Split tally/reports.py into the tally/reports/ package (errors, tables, state, system, formatting, model, loading, aggregate, renderers, cli), all files under 400 lines, with layered imports and no cycles. The 63 tests pass. About 490 CLI runs gave identical stdout, stderr and exit status against the original; only traceback frame lines differ, as they must. Public API, signatures and __all__ are unchanged and private names are gone. Running `python -m tally.reports` directly no longer works, because the guide forbids a __main__.py.
